name: Rayssa Leal x Nike Dunk Low SB
story_html: The Rayssa Leal x Nike Dunk Low SB debuts a special-edition colorway designed in collaboration with the Brazilian skateboarder. Mismatched blue and fuchsia Swooshes adorn the upper, featuring a white leather base with patterned grey suede overlays. Rayssa's personal logo decorates the lateral heel, while a trio of multicolored lace charms display digital smiley faces. The same graphic is embossed in a repeating pattern throughout each quarter panel. Underfoot, a gum rubber outsole provides grippy traction.
details: Pure Platinum/Deep Royal Blue/Vivid Purple/White/Gum Yellow
